# eetree-sim 1
# name charge-pump-dickson3
# param VIN 5
# param f 100000
# param C 1e-06
# param Co 1e-05
# param RL 1000
# let dt = 1/(f*200)
# let sp = 100
$ 1 ${dt} ${sp} 50 ${VIN*4} 50
d 144 96 192 96 1 0.35
c 240 136 240 184 0 ${C} 0 0
d 288 96 336 96 1 0.35
c 384 136 384 184 0 ${C} 0 0
d 432 96 480 96 1 0.35
c 528 136 528 184 0 ${C} 0 0
d 576 96 624 96 1 0.35
c 672 168 672 216 0 ${Co} 0 0
r 768 168 768 216 0 ${RL}
g 672 288 672 304 0 0
R 96 96 64 96 0 0 40 ${VIN} 0 0 0.5
R 240 224 240 256 0 2 ${f} ${VIN/2} ${VIN/2} 0 0.5
R 384 224 384 256 0 2 ${f} ${-VIN/2} ${VIN/2} 0 0.5
R 528 224 528 256 0 2 ${f} ${VIN/2} ${VIN/2} 0 0.5
207 848 96 880 96 0 VOUT

x 64 344 264 348 0 14 CLK：0/VIN 方波（${si(f)}Hz），D 为肖特基二极管
o 14 256 0 4098 ${VIN*4} 0.01 0 1
